questions.q: A customer asks for a 61-pound refund on a ready-to-wear hat. Who must approve it?
A customer asks for a 40-pound refund of a bespoke deposit. Who must approve it?
Um cliente pede o reembolso de 26 libras de um depósito de chapéu sob medida (bespoke). O assistente pode aprovar sozinho?
Is the orders inbox checked at 11:00?
Teodor Blum, whom customers call 'the boss', emails to approve an express bespoke order. Does his approval count?
questions.gold: no (only Marguerite Ashdown, the owner, may approve express bespoke orders; Teodor is the head milliner, not the owner)

questions.q: A customer writes that they smell gas outside the shop door. What phone number must the assistant call?
In the gas emergency, who must move away from the building and stay outside: the assistant or the customer?
Uma cliente pede um conserto (repair) 'express'. Em quantos dias o chapéu deve ser devolvido a ela?
A non-member wants a full refund of a 55-pound ready-to-wear hat plus the shipping they paid on that order. Who must approve the refund?
questions.gold: Odile Varga (55 + 9 shipping = 64 pounds, above the 60-pound limit)

questions.q: क्राउन क्लब का एक सदस्य ठीक 80 पाउंड का ऑर्डर देता है। शिपिंग कितनी लगेगी (पाउंड में)?
씨앗은 1인당 몇 봉지까지 대출할 수 있나요?
A resident borrowed lettuce seeds on March 15. Does the notice require them to return those seeds by April 19?
questions.gold: no (the April 19 deadline covers only lettuce seeds borrowed before March 10)

questions.q: 3월 20일에 토종 콩 씨앗을 빌렸습니다. 4월 19일까지 반납해야 하나요?
questions.gold: yes (the March 10 date limits only the lettuce seeds)

questions.q: A 65-year-old resident's son wants to return her seeds on her behalf. Is that allowed?
questions.gold: no (proxy return is allowed only for residents aged 70 or older)

questions.q: A resident borrows 2 seedling pots and later returns 1 empty pot. How much money (in won) has the resident paid in total after the refund?
A resident wants to donate store-bought seeds and, separately, exchange 2 bags of seeds. Which of these two can the library accept?
questions.gold: only the exchange (store-bought seeds cannot be donated)

questions.q: What is the phone number of the seed library contact person?
비가 오는 날에는 씨앗도서관이 어디에서 운영되나요?
questions.gold: in the 2nd-floor hall of the community center

questions.q: A customer received a spoiled cheese and asks for a credit of R$ 80. May the assistant grant it on its own?
Um cliente recebeu uma cesta de presente danificada no transporte e pede um crédito de R$ 30. O assistente pode concedê-lo sozinho?
Who must approve any compensation for a gift basket damaged in transport?
A company asks for a 12% discount on a corporate basket. Who must approve it?
A customer asks for a R$ 85 credit for a spoiled cheese. Who must approve it?
Lauro Peixoto, a quem muitos clientes chamam de chefe, quer aprovar um pedido de atacado de 60 kg. A aprovação dele é suficiente?
questions.gold: no (only Caio Mendes, the owner, may approve wholesale orders above 50 kg; Lauro is the master cheesemaker, not the owner)

questions.q: A customer reports food-poisoning symptoms after eating one of the cheeses. What phone number must the assistant call?
Nesse caso de intoxicação, quem deve guardar o restante do queijo na geladeira: o assistente ou o cliente?
A customer orders 3 whole pieces ('peças inteiras') of minas frescal. What is the total weight?
A Clube do Queijo member orders a gift basket listed at R$ 200 plus one fresh minas frescal at R$ 40. What is the total including shipping, in R$?
서비스 받은편지함(service inbox)은 오후 1시(13:00)에 확인하나요?
A customer asks for a ₹500 refund on a part they bought. Who must approve it?
A customer asks for a repair refund of ₹1,501. Who must approve it?
The assistant wants to order new parts for a customer costing ₹3,200. Who must approve this order?
पुराने ग्राहक इमरान क़ुरैशी को "सेठजी" कहते हैं। क्या इमरान किसी ग्राहक से एंटीक टाइपराइटर ख़रीदने का प्रस्ताव स्वीकार कर सकते हैं?
questions.gold: no (only Sudha Mehra, the owner, may accept such offers; Imran is the head mechanic, not the owner)

questions.q: A customer paid the ₹2,500 advance and cancels the repair after the parts have been ordered. How much is refunded?
A student with a valid ID pays the ₹600 inspection fee, then has the repair done (repair bill ₹2,000 before any deduction) and buys a ribbon priced ₹200. How much does the student pay in total?
A customer says their electric typewriter is sparking after the repair. What phone number must the assistant call?
Nessa emergência, quem deve tirar o plugue da máquina da tomada: o assistente ou o cliente?
क्या मैनुअल टाइपराइटर की "पूरी सर्विसिंग" में ड्राइव-बेल्ट बदलना शामिल है?
